article_title: Plug-in solar panels are coming to a shop near you - what to know

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly explaining?
options: How new UK rules allow plug-in solar panels to be sold, and what buyers should know about cost, output and safety
Why the UK has banned all forms of household solar power
How households can earn a guaranteed salary by exporting solar electricity
Why every plug-in panel must be installed permanently by an electrician
tasks.correct_answer: How new UK rules allow plug-in solar panels to be sold, and what buyers should know about cost, output and safety
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה את שינוי הכללים בבריטניה ואת השיקולים המעשיים לקונה: מחיר, חיסכון, תפוקה, בטיחות והתקנה.

tasks.prompt: How much does government research suggest a household could save each year?
options: Between £7 and £11
Between £70 and £110
Exactly £400
More than £1,089
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחקר הממשלה מעריך חיסכון שנתי של 70–110 ליש״ט, בהתאם למיקום הפאנלים ולאופן השימוש בחשמל.

tasks.prompt: What limits the amount of power delivered from a plug-in kit to the home?
options: The electricity supplier limits it to 80 watts
The mounting frame limits it to 3 kilowatts
The microinverter limits the output to 800 watts
The household's kettle limits it to 20 watts
tasks.correct_answer: The microinverter limits the output to 800 watts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המיקרו־ממיר מגביל את ההספק המוזן לבית ל־800 ואט, גם אם הפאנלים עצמם מסוגלים לייצר יותר.

tasks.prompt: What safety action does the microinverter take during a power cut or when the panel is unplugged?
options: It sends all remaining electricity to the kettle
It increases the panel voltage to restart the grid
It keeps supplying the house for 28 days
It detects the disconnection and shuts down within milliseconds
tasks.correct_answer: It detects the disconnection and shuts down within milliseconds
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המיקרו־ממיר מנטר את חיבור הרשת ומפסיק את ההזנה בתוך אלפיות שנייה, כדי שלא להזרים מתח לחיווט שאינו פעיל.

tasks.prompt: What does “settle” mean when the government expects prices to settle at £400–£600?
options: To be paid only in cash
To stabilise around a particular range
To increase without any upper limit
To include free professional installation
tasks.correct_answer: To stabilise around a particular range
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה settle פירושו להתייצב סביב טווח מחירים מסוים לאחר שהתחרות והמבחר יגדלו.

tasks.prompt: What does “consumed” mean in the statement that unused power flows back to the grid?
options: Certified by an official scheme
Generated after sunset
Used by the household
Stored permanently inside the socket
tasks.explanation_hebrew: consumed פירושו נצרך או נעשה בו שימוש; חשמל שלא נצרך בבית זורם חזרה לרשת.

tasks.prompt: Give three differences between plug-in solar panels and conventional rooftop solar systems described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה הבדלים קונקרטיים מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: Plug-in kits are significantly cheaper
They can be installed without an electrician after suitable checks
They generate less power than rooftop systems
Their home output is limited to 800 watts
They do not need MCS certification
They normally do not qualify for Smart Export Guarantee payments
They are not permanently attached and can be moved

tasks.prompt: Why will a south-facing household that uses electricity during daylight usually benefit more from the panels?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין כיוון הפאנל, הצללה, שעות הייצור וזמן צריכת החשמל.
expected_points: An unshaded south-facing position receives favourable sunlight
The panels generate electricity only when sufficient sunlight is available
The electricity is most valuable when used as it is generated
Unused electricity flows back to the grid
Households are unlikely to be paid for exported power from these systems

tasks.prompt: Summarise the main financial, technical and safety points a buyer should know before purchasing a plug-in solar kit.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול לפחות נקודה אחת מכל תחום: עלות/חיסכון, תפוקה ושימוש, ובטיחות/התאמה לבית.
expected_points: Initial kits are priced at £699 for one panel and £1,089 for two, with lower future prices expected
Estimated annual savings are £70–£110
Output to the home is limited to 800 watts
The system can cover some always-on loads but cannot power an entire home alone
Wiring should be checked by a registered electrician, especially in older homes
Buyers should verify G98 and product-specification compliance
Extension leads, cable reels and plug-in adaptors should not be used
The DNO must be notified within 28 days

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to a renter considering a plug-in solar panel for a balcony. Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתת המלצה מאוזנת באנגלית ולהתייחס להתאמת המקום, רשות בעל הנכס, בטיחות ותועלת אפשרית.
expected_points: Check that the balcony or outdoor area has an unshaded suitable orientation
Ask the landlord, freeholder or building owner for any required permission
Have the wiring checked before purchase
Choose a compliant product from an established retailer
Do not connect through an extension lead, cable reel or adaptor
Expect modest output and savings rather than full home power
Plan to notify the DNO within 28 days after connection
Note that the unit can be moved because it is not permanently attached
